name: Salmeterol
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Serevent Diskus (salmeterol xinafoate), Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — t½ ≈ 5.5 hours
halfLifeNotes: From a 1 mg oral radiolabeled dose in healthy adults, measurable in one volunteer only; plasma levels after inhaled therapeutic doses are very low or undetectable, and the xinafoate counter-ion has its own ~11-day half-life.
